subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the 14 grouped action-pin upgrades be approved together for the secret-bearing, write-capable, release, and security workflows on this exact head?
rationale: The patch itself is mechanically consistent, but selecting new executable third-party action versions for privileged workflows is an ownership and security-boundary decision that PR CI cannot fully settle.

options.title: Approve after exact-head gates
options.body: Keep the grouped immutable pins and merge after security/workflow owners confirm upstream provenance and all required checks complete successfully.

options.title: Split privileged upgrades
options.body: Separate Codex, GitHub App token, Docker publishing, and security-scanning actions so each sensitive runtime change can be reviewed and rolled back independently.

options.title: Hold current pins
options.body: Pause this update if owners cannot validate the privileged action changes or their production-only workflows with sufficient confidence.

recommendation.title: Approve after exact-head gates
recommendation.body: Keep the grouped immutable pins and merge after security/workflow owners confirm upstream provenance and all required checks complete successfully.

likelyOwner.reason: The history shows the strongest cross-cutting ownership of CI and Codex-agent workflows, and this person is already explicitly connected to the PR timeline.
